faqs.question: When is the Discovery Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Discovery Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026. The event will be held in Cebu City, Philippines, at the City Di Mare venue located within the South Road Properties area, organized by KNC.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at the Discovery Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Discovery Marathon 2026 offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 12km race, and a shorter 6km race, catering to a range of runner experience levels.

faqs.question: Where is the Discovery Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The event takes place at City Di Mare, located within the South Road Properties area of Cebu City, Philippines. This venue serves as the host site for all distance categories offered during the Discovery Marathon 2026, organized by KNC.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Discovery Marathon 2026?
